messages.subject: Best Deployment of Shiny Open Source Server
parts:
Can anybody Please tell me the best server and best configuration to use for this usecase. Where a shiny app will probably be used by around 53 to 54 people inserting, updating, deleting data from a postgresQL backend Database along with fetching the Data to see if the CRUD has worked fine or not.

Apart from this a few Manager around 5 will look at some dashboards I will have to create.

so I want to know

1. Which server should I buy
2. What minimum configuration do I need
3. What should I do so that the server should not crash and work even in speed latency ( as Indian InterNet is not usually fast).


I was googling servers and I came across
1. Azure cloud
2. AWS
3. Digital ocean
4. Docker and kubernetes
etc etc. I have no idea what they are but they all seem pretty different.

I know nothing about a server But I would still like to have the best deployment strategy. I have to learn one of it so why not learn the Best one. So which of them is best for shiny application. 

Please do let me know. it's crucial for me.
